entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jacques Ledoux was a Polish-born Belgian cinema specialist, the first curator of the Royal Film Archive of Belgium from 1948 to 1988 and the founder of the Cinema Museum in Brussels in 1962. He was born in Warsaw and died in Brussels.
